# Results (generated by tools/results.py from outputs/data/metrics.json; do not edit by hand)

Reference: net replacement fading from the 2018-2023 rate to the long-run rate (half-life 10 yr); 2026-2050; median demographics unless marked MC (joint uncertainty within the Reference). Carbon factors: A1-A3 of case-study items decarbonised 2026-2050 (Horup et al. 2025; item-level mapping, data/material_item_map.csv); A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)) (Resch et al. 2021); C1-C4, held items and soil carbon loss at 2025. Accounting: time-resolved (materials and construction (A1-A5) and soil carbon loss in the construction year; maintenance (B2, B4) in the year it occurs, 2026-2050; later B2/B4 and end of life (C1-C4) are committed after 2050, below).
